earnings.title: Supermicro Announces First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Net sales of $19.9 billion versus $11.1 billion in Q4'26 and $5.0 billion in Q1'26.
Net income of $1,594 million versus $1,178 million in Q4'26 and $168 million in Q1'26.
Diluted net income per common share of $1.75 versus $1.62 in Q4'26 and $0.26 in Q1'26.
Non-GAAP diluted net income per common share of $1.81 versus $0.35 in Q1'26.
Gross margin of 12.7% versus 17.5% in Q4'26 and 9.3% in Q1'26.

quotes.text: Supermicro’s transformation into a Total AI and IT Datacenter Solution provider continues to accelerate, delivering record revenue of $19.9 billion for the first quarter fiscal 2027.
quotes.by: Charles Liang, Founder, President, and CEO of Supermicro

outlook: The Company expects net sales in the range of $19.5 billion and $21.5 billion for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 ending December 31, 2026, GAAP net income per diluted share of $1.59 to $1.83 and non-GAAP net income per diluted share of $1.66 to $1.90.

The Company’s projections for GAAP and non-GAAP net income per diluted share assume a tax rate of approximately 21.2% and 21.1%, respectively, and a fully diluted share count of 753 million shares for GAAP and fully diluted share count of 769 million shares for non-GAAP.

The outlook for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 GAAP net income per diluted share includes approximately $89 million in expected stock-based compensation expense, net of related tax effects of $22 million that are excluded from non-GAAP net income per diluted share.
For fiscal year 2027, the Company expects net sales in the range of $72.0 billion to $82.0 billion.
